positioning: 以 CAD/EDA 流程与验证基础设施为第一入口，发挥 RTL、FPGA 和自动化工具优势，逐步形成可复现、可诊断的芯片工程能力。
positioningEn: Target CAD and EDA-flow infrastructure as the first entry point, using RTL, FPGA, and automation strengths to build reproducible, diagnosable silicon-engineering capability.
strengths: 晶体管级设计与定制电路基础
RTL 与 FPGA 从模型到硬件验证
体系结构、内存与可靠性分析
C++、Python、Tcl 与芯片工程自动化能力
时序、资源、功耗、测试结果与失败原因的证据化表达
strengthsEn: RTL and FPGA work from models through hardware validation
Computer architecture, memory, and reliability analysis
C++, Python, Tcl, and silicon-engineering automation
Evidence-based communication of timing, resources, power, tests, and failure causes
criticalGaps: 实验室、芯片实习或开源上游贡献中的至少一项
UVM、SVA、形式验证、覆盖率、CDC 与 RDC 的生产级证据
从综合到布局布线、STA、签核与 PPA 收敛的完整流程
可复现且有基准对比的 C++ EDA 算法项目
RTL、验证、系统设计面试与技术英语基线
收敛公开作品集并用少量旗舰项目建立统一叙事
criticalGapsEn: At least one laboratory role, silicon internship, or upstream open-source contribution
Production-grade evidence in UVM, SVA, formal verification, coverage, CDC, and RDC
A complete flow from synthesis through place and route, STA, signoff, and PPA closure
A reproducible C++ EDA algorithm project with benchmark comparisons
A calibrated RTL, verification, system-design, and technical-English interview baseline
A focused public portfolio with one coherent story across a small set of flagship projects
